name: Glutathione Reductase

structure._alt_note: 3GRS is another human glutathione reductase structure, and appears in the dashboard text as '3DJJ/3GRS'. The example campaign docks 3DJJ. The alias is registered here so that a lookup for 3GRS resolves to hGR and not to some other target -- in an older hardcoded target table 3GRS had been assigned to a parasite cysteine protease, which is the kind of error this registry exists to make impossible.
structure._cofactor_copies_note: 1 FAD, not 2: the 3DJJ structure used here is monomeric, whereas TcTR/LiTR (1BZL/2JK6) deposit 2 chains and therefore 2 flavins. The count matters when preparing the receptor: dropping a cofactor that the site needs is the quiet way to lose the pocket.

notes: FAD essential. Human counterpart of trypanothione reductase: same reaction on a different thiol, glutathione instead of trypanothione. Its active site is narrower, and that difference in architecture is the molecular basis of any selectivity claim -- which is why the platform docks the parasite enzyme and this one under the same protocol.
